items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He and I teamed up together and we went to the Follies in the burlesque house there. They had an amateur hour and strangely enough man, we won first prize.

ctx.x: I was about eight or nine years old. And funny thing, not a funny thing, but Lionel Hampton was, you know, from LA and I’d see him at the Lincoln Theater. And Lionel would take the sticks and play all over the floor, and the wall, and all over and I imitated -- I could do that. I’d imitate Lionel, right? So when we were in junior high school there was a piano player by the name of Chooie Reyes. He was a piano player who later became a Mexican piano player who later became very famous. His name was Chooie Reyes.…
